name: web_get_content
description: Extract readable text content from the current browser page. Use this for reading, research, and content extraction — not for navigation. Returns the page's visible text with scripts, styles, and navigation elements removed. Ideal for extracting headlines, article text, prices, or any textual data from a page already loaded in the browser.

inputs.name: max_chars
inputs.description: Maximum characters of text to return. Default 15000. Range: 1000-50000.

outputs.description: Page URL, title, and extracted text content.
True if text was truncated to max_chars.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `web_get_content`.

Return ONLY a JSON object with:
- max_chars (number, optional, default 15000)

Example:
{"max_chars": 15000}
